title: The book as a coordination system
summary: Foundation provides the physics, Application provides the proof, Transcendence provides the stakes. Remove any triad and the book collapses; together they produce a way of seeing that changes how you act, which is the claim the book itself makes about coordination.
source: ChX — 'The Nine Chapters as a Coordination System' (replaces the Ostrom commons figure)
